correctness.rationale: For all bounded positive measurable equimeasurable diffusivities, optical length Y is invariant and the model is explicitly defined through the inverse optical map. Rearrangement gives the sharp allowed prefix distances. The exact upper-reflection Skorokhod map is monotone and nonexpansive in starting u, preserving first-hitting order. Common Brownian increments and renewal epochs propagate the hitting-time inequality cycle by cycle. A positive independent per-attempt chance gives almost-sure completion without moment assumptions. Continuous sliding of sorted reciprocal-square-root diffusivity realizes every possible prefix. Direct Poisson Laplace and mean formulas agree with established source Eq. (19). The bundled Python checks 66,696 finite assertions; they are not substitutes for the argument.

value.rationale: Fixing a spatial diffusivity histogram is a natural resource-constrained material-design question for heterogeneous target search. The theorem identifies a simultaneous optimum for entire completion-time distributions, every quantile and every increasing cost, uniformly across arbitrary independent renewal clocks, not merely a narrow gain at a chosen resetting rate. The exact interval of all attainable laws is a complete and robust classification. Its physical limitations (optical prescription, common reset site and clock) are explicit.
